hooks.command: python3 -c "import json,sys,os,fnmatch; p=json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path','').replace(os.sep,'/'); b=fnmatch.fnmatch(os.path.basename(p),'.env*') or any(fnmatch.fnmatch(p,g) for g in ('*/infra/prod/*','*/migrations/*')); b and print('Blocked: '+p+' is protected; ask the user first', file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(2 if b else 0)"
